name: Air Fryer Greek Chicken Souvlaki Bowls

components.name: Chicken Souvlaki

ingredients.name: Raw boneless skinless chicken thighs, medium chunks

steps: Stir lemon, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper and coat the raw chicken. Marinate covered for at least 20 minutes.
Preheat air fryer to 200 C. Thread chicken onto short food-safe skewers that fit the basket or leave loose.
Air fry in separate batches around 12-16 minutes, turning halfway and checking all chicken reaches 74 C.

components.name: Couscous

ingredients.name: Water or hot stock for couscous

steps: Make the measured couscous using just-boiled water, cover and fluff. In a small bowl, mix yogurt, lemon and mint for the chilled sauce.

components.name: Yogurt Sauce & Salad
steps: Chop tomato and cucumber and store in a separate sealed container. Portion chicken and couscous for five meals, serve with cold sauce and salad.
